entries.title: Psalms 134:1
segments: A Song of degrees. Behold, bless the LORD, all servants of the LORD, who stand by night in the house of the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 134:2
segments: Lift up your hands [in] the sanctuary, and bless the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 134:3
segments: [May] the LORD, who made the heavens and earth, bless you out of Zion.
